note: Feasibility audit only. No policy outcomes computed.
metadata_commit_note: This metadata file is committed separately after the frozen analysis snapshot. The analysis_commit identifies the repository snapshot containing the exact research code, artifacts, archive, and normalized input-data blob.

input_data_working_tree_identity.hash_scope: Pre-freeze working-tree bytes used by the analysis before Git text normalization

line_ending_normalization_note: Git stored the CSV with LF line endings because core.autocrlf=true and no path-specific attributes were present. The repository blob is identified by git_blob_oid; the original analysis-input bytes are identified by the working-tree SHA-256. Converting the blob from LF to CRLF reproduces the recorded SHA-256 exactly, confirming line-ending normalization and nothing else accounts for the difference.
frozen_package_cleanliness_scope: Only the approved WR-bust research package paths committed in analysis_commit.
repository_worktree_note: Unrelated modified or untracked project paths were intentionally excluded from the frozen WR-bust research package. Their presence does not affect reproducibility of the committed analysis package.
provenance_clarification_note: analysis_commit identifies an immutable Git snapshot of the frozen WR-bust package. Cleanliness claims apply to that package scope, not to the repository-wide working tree.
analysis_commit_dirty_scope_note: analysis_commit_dirty is PACKAGE-SCOPED, not repository-scoped: it records that every path committed in analysis_commit matched its committed state, and makes no claim about unrelated paths elsewhere in the working tree. See repository_worktree_globally_clean_at_freeze.
